subject: Onboarding verification — background & training artifacts for Fenwick Capital
messages:
From: Samantha Klein <samantha.klein@bluepeakaudit.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maria Fernandez <maria.fernandez@fenwick.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — personnel verification (SOC 2 scope)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. As part of our limited-scope SOC 2 review for Fenwick Capital (controls tied to vendor data access), we need artifacts showing that Redwood's onboarding controls for personnel with access to Fenwick customer data are in place. Can you provide the following items for hires in the last 12 months who had access to Fenwick PRD (redacted where necessary):

- Verification that background checks were completed and results summary (redacted PII is fine)
- Training completion logs for security awareness and data handling (timestamps and course ids)
- The onboarding/deprovisioning runbook that controls access revocation timelines

If you can bundle as CSV/PDF/Docx and share via a secure Drive link or SFTP, that works. Goal is to have these artifacts by Friday so we can finish the control walkthrough next week.

Thanks,
Samantha Klein
Senior Auditor
BluePeak Audit

---
Note: we can accept redacted transcripts and hashed identifiers.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Klein <samantha.klein@bluepeakaudit.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — personnel verification (SOC 2 scope)

Samantha — thanks for the note and clear list. Looping in Rishi (security) and Laura (HR ops) — they'll collate the artifacts and coordinate delivery.

Quick logistics: HR will produce a redacted CSV summary for the background checks, security will attach training logs, and I'll provide the live onboarding/deprovisioning playbook (internal doc). Are hashed employee IDs acceptable for cross-referencing? Also, do you want only personnel who had explicit PRD access to Fenwick, or anyone in the same role bucket?

Planned delivery: preliminary bundle by Thu EOD, final by Fri. If that meets your timeline we'll upload to a shared Drive folder and provide read-only links.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this reply

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Klein <samantha.klein@bluepeakaudit.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — personnel verification (SOC 2 scope)

Marissa / Rishi / Samantha —

We can produce a redacted background-check inventory. Deliverables I will include:

- fenwick_newhire_bg_checks.csv (columns: hire_date, role, bg_check_type, verification_status, hashed_employee_id)
- training-completion-logs-2026Q3.pdf (export from LMS with course IDs and completion timestamps; names redacted)
- summary memo describing redaction methodology and retention windows

Samantha — for clarity: we'll include only employees who were granted PRD-level credentials tied to the Fenwick account (permission timestamp between 2025-10-01 and 2026-09-30). Hashing method: SHA256 of employee_id + static salt (we'll include salt verification process under NDA if needed).

I will request the exports from VettedHire for background results and from our LMS for training logs; VettedHire typically provides CSVs within 24 hours — looping their support on this request.

Laura
HR Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (exports pending)

From: VettedHire Support <support@vettedhire.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Export: background checks for Fenwick scope

Hi Laura / Marissa —

Attached is the export you requested for the date range 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30. Filenames attached: fenwick_newhire_bg_checks.csv (redacted per your spec). Delivery notes: results marked "Verified" or "Clear" indicate completed checks; any records with "Adverse" will remain redacted per screening vendor policy — let us know if you need additional attestation letters.

Attachment (stub): fenwick_newhire_bg_checks.csv (CSV, 12KB)

Best,
VettedHire Support

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Klein <samantha.klein@bluepeakaudit.com>, Maria Fernandez <maria.fernandez@fenwick.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — personnel verification (SOC 2 scope)

Samantha / Maria —

We have uploaded the initial bundle to the shared Drive folder and set read-only permissions to the BluePeak and Fenwick audit accounts. Contents uploaded:

1) fenwick_newhire_bg_checks.csv (redacted export from VettedHire)
2) training-completion-logs-2026Q3.pdf (LMS export, names redacted)
3) onboarding-deprovision-playbook-Redwood.docx (internal runbook with access revocation timelines)
4) staff_redaction_methodology.pdf (short memo describing hashing and redaction steps)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleDriveLink

Next steps: Rishi will be available for the control walkthrough on Tue 11/02 at 10:00 PT — please confirm if that time works. If you need DocuSign attestation or vendor letters for any adverse-screen findings, Laura can coordinate.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
